task_reconstruction.official_task: 2023 MCM Problem C, restated on page 3.
required_outputs: a prediction interval for the number of reports on 1 March 2023
whether word attributes change the Hard Mode share, and how
the reported-result distribution for EERIE with its uncertainty
a difficulty classification of solution words, including EERIE
other features of the data and a letter to the puzzle editor

contributions.summary: The order is chosen by stepwise AICc after the plots are called subjective.
A player's state is reduced to three colour counts, giving 384 states.
Two strategies are mixed by a cross-entropy fit and predicted by a Gaussian process.
Difficulty is a weighted score with the failure bin counted as eight guesses.

dependency_graph.label: The EERIE distribution checks the hard label.

assumptions.summary: Players make only locally optimal choices from what they currently know.
Most of the time the answer is a common word.
A player keeps the green tiles already earned.
Players share one word bank and one subjective probability.
Higher information gain means lower probability.
The strategy mix does not change within a day.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Only the official COMAP file is used.
rprobe corrected to probe, clen to clean, tash to trash.
Word frequency comes from a Kaggle list of 333,333 words.

models.summary: MU-C-Q241-002: attribute regression reduced by LASSO.
MU-C-Q241-003: absorbing Markov chain on colour triples.
MU-C-Q241-005: strategy mixture and Gaussian process.

verification.summary: ADF passes only after one difference; Box-Ljung rejects white noise at 253.36.
Residuals are white noise, so no further model is built.
Three Kullback-Leibler divergences separate the classes.
Changing C from 1 to 3 barely moves the forecast.

results_trace.summary: Reduced fit Y = 0.0750 - 0.0035 X1 + 0.2663 X2, adjusted R squared 0.782.
EERIE classified hard; the summary prints ERRIE once.
parer at 0.48 and foyer at 0.26 for seven or more tries.

writing_logic.summary: Each contest question gets its own paragraph, opened by First, Then, Next or Finally.
Three readings of one figure are refused before the search replaces them.
A result that should be impossible is stated, then explained through Twitter.
The letter credits the reader and retells every model as one sentence.

language_observations.summary: Since its launch, we dig into the information hidden behind.
Which is known as, the basic idea is that, once this sequence is identified.
Difficult and subjective, not sufficient to judge by this alone.
We know that, however, this may be because.
Dear Sir or Madam, in this era of bombardment, it is surprising that.

visualization_observations.summary: ACF, PACF and the series, read as having no seasonal trend.
The differenced series fluctuates around one value with no trend.
The fitted curve after the order is fixed.
Residual ACF inside the band, Ljung-Box p-values above 0.05, Q-Q near a line.
Sixty forecast days with the interval [10517, 27007].
The six word attributes collected before the regression.
Four diagnostic panels, each tied to one assumption.
One example chain through the 384 states.
Three difficulty densities, called obviously different.
Fifteen words solved on the first guess more than one percent of the time.
Predictions at C equal to 1, 2 and 3, nearly overlapping.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: Declining the plot readings makes the automated order look careful.
The letter turns four models into statements an editor can repeat.

weaknesses.summary: Only part of the word features are used, and the missing ones are not named.
The paper admits an arbitrary mindset in part of the design.
The prose calls 2022-2-18 a plunge while Table 5 lists it as a sudden increase.

independent_extensions.summary: Name the unused word features and test whether any of them moves the Hard Mode share.
Replace the fixed offset C with a value estimated per day.

candidate_rule_impacts.summary: Open the summary from the phenomenon, not from the model.
List the readings you reject before the procedure you adopt.

unresolved_questions: Why does this paper correct the same cell to 25569 when another paper corrects it to 25690?
Which value of C produces the reported EERIE distribution?
What kernel does the Gaussian process use?
Why does the prose reverse the direction of two dates in Table 5?
